title: Tutorial and Mentor Guidance (VO + holograms)
description:
Purpose: Contextual mentor VO and holograms that guide movement, constructs, and recharging. Tips appear when the player struggles; can be muted in settings; avoids copyrighted phrases.

Hooks:
- On scene entry (central_battery_plaza, training_arena), deliver onboarding lines and hologram projections.
- On repeated failure (e.g., hazard deaths), deliver gentle tips.
- On recharge station proximity, deliver paraphrased ritual prompt.

Controls: N/A (dialogue triggers); can be muted via Accessibility settings.

Components:
- Reads: mission_system events, player progress, settings (mute VO).
- Writes: Dialogue playback, hologram spawn (original_lantern_mentor_npc), subtitle overlays with speaker tags.

Acceptance hooks:
- Provides guidance throughout tutorials; no direct automated test.

Integration and depends_on:
- Trigger via builtin.dialogue_trigger where needed with hook_id="mentor_guidance_dialogue".
- Depends on mission_system for context.

Suggested file split: mentor_dialogue_register.cpp, mentor_lines.cpp, mentor_triggers.cpp.
